proofs.title: a killed worker's Attempt is closed from OUTSIDE with its partial evidence preserved
proofs.detail: the child exited 137 holding an open Attempt; the sweep closed it as LEASE_EXPIRED, preserved 1 partial artifact(s), left the task RECLAIMABLE and wrote NO disposition

proofs.title: concurrent appends to one log key take DISTINCT positions
proofs.detail: 4 processes appended 12 records each; 48 rows landed with 48 distinct position(s). A duplicate position here would make the replay order ambiguous, which is what reconcile() walks.

proofs.title: the stored next-due answers a due-time query, and an index exists to serve it
proofs.detail: 3 of 5 obligations are due at 2026-08-31T14:20:40.954Z, returned soonest-first. Planner: Bitmap Heap Scan on cp_obligations  (cost=9.11..21.93 rows=125 width=32) |   Recheck Cond: (((value ->> 'nextDueAt'::text) <= '2026-08-31T14:20:40.954Z'::text)

evidence.plan: Bitmap Heap Scan on cp_obligations  (cost=9.11..21.93 rows=125 width=32) |   Recheck Cond: (((value ->> 'nextDueAt'::text) <= '2026-08-31T14:20:40.954Z'::text) AND ((value ->> 'active'::text))::boolean) |   ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cp_obligations_next_due  (cost=0.00..9.08 rows=125 width=0) |         Index Cond: ((value ->> 'nextDueAt'::text) <= '2026-08-31T14:20:40.954Z'::text)
